Q.reason: Direct Plugin API image transport is viable for supported raster formats, but the low-resolution study derivative became visibly soft when enlarged and its generated blank-frame geometry did not align tightly enough with existing native photo/text roles. transportLearning.replacementMethod: Drive/source bytes -> supported JPEG/PNG derivative -> figma.createImage(Uint8Array) -> IMAGE fill. This bypasses the failing mcp.figma.com submit path and is now locally proven for JPEG.
transportLearning.qualityGate: Transport success does not equal adoption. Use role-appropriate high-resolution derivatives and align generated decoration with native replaceable photo/text roles before production promotion.
